blocks.text: Good progress to report. The knockout searches are done, and most of the candidates came through the first pass clean. Two dropped out against marks already registered for close goods, which is exactly what the knockout stage is for, and we are moving the survivors into the full clearance search now.

Kelly Snyder has the search record current, so every candidate, class, and hit for the {{fact:f:E-2024-001.client}} clearance is captured in one place as we go. On the survivors, we are searching the federal register, the state registries, and the common-law sources together rather than one after another, so that we do not lose time.

One thing from you would help. For the two candidates that dropped, tell us whether Jackson Inc wants a substitute mark added to the search, so that we can fold it in now rather than open a second pass later. Our contact record shows Cynthia Hunter's approval of the search order, and we are following it. None of this is a conclusion yet; the view on whether each surviving mark is safe to adopt comes in the written report, after counsel has reviewed it.
